organs.Notes: B16 tumour-bearing nude mice (no BALB/c subline or sex explicitly stated); Ir1 i.p.daily15days, all animals sacrificed day16 per Methods, despite Fig11 curves ending at7days. Cohort n5 per arm; histology animal n not stated. Comparator saline, cisplatin3mg/kg also shown. Saline control has liver metastases and subarachnoid brain haemorrhage. Authors describe clear alveolar/bronchial lung structures and normal glomerular structure/number/size after Ir1; kidney assessment limited to glomeruli. Liver phrase says no obvious metastasis and slight necrosis after3mg/kg and6mg/kg respectively; dose-to-finding mapping ambiguous. Necrosis retained as shared raw damage, per-dose liver Outcome blank; absence of metastases is not absence of drug injury. Heart/spleen/brain treatment-specific assessment absent; saline findings not inherited. logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the complexes was determined by the shake flask method using distilled water and n-octanol as the solvent [37]. The n-octanol and distilled water were pre-saturated with each other before use. The complexes were dissolved in the pre-saturated n-octanol. 5 mL of the above solution and the pre-saturated 5 mL of distilled water were added in 15-mL centrifuge tube. The mixture was shaken vigorously for 24 h, and then the organic and water phase were separated. The concentrations of the complexes in each phase were measured by the UV/Vis spectrophotometer. Experiments were performed in triplicate. The partition coefficients P were calculated from the ratio Coct/Cwater, where Coct and Cwater were the concentrations of the complexes in the n-octanol and in the water, respectively. Equilibration and absorption measurements were performed at room temperature.
